About

Studying IT, building for accessibility.

I study Information Technology at Borg El Arab Technological University. I like projects where software, hardware and people meet, and where the result is something you can hold and use.

As part of a 24-student team, I worked on SignBridge, a bidirectional communication device for Deaf and hearing people. It was presented as our first-year project in the 2025/2026 academic year.

First-year project

SignBridge

Sign language in, speech out. Speech in, text out.

SignBridge is an AI-powered portable embedded system that translates Arabic sign language into real-time spoken words using MediaPipe and low-latency audio caching. At the same time, a background microphone captures spoken dialogue and shows it as clean text on a touchscreen, so both people can talk without an interpreter.

Featured

SignBridge in the news.

On 15 August 2026, the Egyptian news website Al-Masry Al-Aan published a report on our project and shared it on its Facebook page. The report presents SignBridge as a smart system that closes the communication gap between Deaf people and the rest of society.

almsryalaan.com

Team

Twenty-four students, one device.

SignBridge was built by 24 IT students, supervised by Prof. Dr. Ashraf Abdelaziz Taha and Eng. Mohamed Osama.
